title: Shankaracharya Temple

buildingCutout.basis: The surveyed historic shrine platform defines replacement without masking the surrounding precinct.

terrainReference.basis: Independent hillside grade at the lower stair in the northern edge of the summit forecourt.

mapIdentity.provider: Named mapped precinct and aerial-derived stone roof registered to Cole’s measured octagonal temple plan.
mapIdentity.scope: The mapped named precinct and aerial-derived stone roof locate the shrine. The scaled 1869 printed survey supplies the measured octagonal terrace and projecting stone stair.

note: John Burke’s exact 1868 photo shows the present temple core before later visitor additions. Cole’s plan defines the stone courses, axial layered entry, roughly 17 m terrace and narrower sanctum. The archaeological survey verifies the 20-foot podium.
